overall: The AG found the Commission violated the law by not completing member certifications until after the complaint, ordered future compliance, and found the November 12 meeting notice was timely posted.

allegations.summary: Members of the Public Works Commission had not completed the required Open Meeting Law certification when the complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission violated the Law in this regard, but subsequently took appropriate remedial action, and we order no further action.

allegations.summary: The agenda for the November 12 Commission meeting was allegedly posted at an unclear time and place, so the notice was not properly posted.
allegations.key_passage: We find that notice of the Commission’s November 12 meeting was timely posted to the City’s website, which is its official notice posting location, and therefore the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law.
